notes: Extracted directly from the supplied ROM binary.
The ROM uses an older pokeemerald-expansion evolution-method enum.
rawParam preserves the exact 16-bit evolution parameter stored in the ROM.
internalOnly=true marks EVO_NONE-style alternate-form routing entries; these are not ordinary player-triggered evolution methods.
Map-section ID 63 resolves to New Mauville from the ROM's own region-map table.
Specific map IDs 6923 and 6995 are preserved as raw IDs; their Moss Rock / icy-area labels are semantic hints based on the Pokémon that use them.
